title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – our complete packages
messages.body:
Hello Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for your quote and for having your CNC capacity ready for the HX series. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%. A current competing offer for this part stands at EUR 33.00 per unit (offer:70240-1).

The attached packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months. One of them includes a 14-day payment term, which supports your cash flow and removes any concern about overdue invoices. Is there a cheaper production variant or material route we should consider on drawing rev. B?

We look forward to your revised complete offer.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – our complete packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Hallo, you did your homework with the index and that other offer, so I'm giving you a big cut down to €31.00. I'm taking the package with 14-day payment because getting the cash in faster is what we need right now. Our current Angebot is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. My guys will check the drawing rev. B for any cheaper ways to make it and get back to you. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. The material indexes dropped a bit, so I can lower the price to €31.00 for you. I kept the 45 days payment but had to change the lead time back to 52 days to give you this discount.

Our current offer is a price of €33.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit, which is at standard terms (a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days). This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
